## Weekly maintenance queue

Turns fixed SOC telemetry into a Sunday checklist: capacity cleanup, stale backups, certificate renewal, slow/unavailable services, failed units, deployment drift, and reboot debt. A seven-day aggregate security pulse provides context without copying raw events to Discord.

This is a planning report, not an auto-remediator. It cannot execute commands, reboot hosts, delete generations, change alerts, or submit arbitrary telemetry queries.
